```dockerfile
# Stage 1: deps
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --ignore-scripts

# Stage 2: build
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN npx tsc --noEmit false \
 && npm prune --omit=dev

# Stage 3: runtime
FROM node:20-alpine AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app
RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S app -G app
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY package.json .
USER app
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Why each choice

**alpine** — ~5MB base vs ~180MB debian.

**3 stages** — deps stage cache npm install separately. Build stage compile + prune. Runtime stage get only prod artifacts.

**`npm ci`** — lockfile-exact install, faster, no write to package-lock.

**`--omit=dev`** — strip devDeps before copy to runtime. Cuts node_modules 40-70%.

**No `npx tsc` in runtime** — `dist/` only. No ts-node, no typescript pkg, no source.

**Non-root user** — `adduser -S` = system user, no password, no home dir bloat.

**`--ignore-scripts`** in deps stage** — skip postinstall scripts during dep fetch. Re-run allowed in build stage where you control context.

## Assumptions + adjust points

| Assumption | If wrong |
|---|---|
| TS output → `dist/` | Change `tsconfig.json` `outDir`, update `COPY` + `CMD` |
| Entry = `dist/index.js` | Update `CMD` |
| No native addons | Add `--ignore-scripts` removal + build tools in build stage |
| Port 3000 | Change `EXPOSE` (cosmetic only) |

## Optional size wins

```dockerfile
# After npm prune, nuke cache
RUN npm cache clean --force

# Or swap node:alpine for distroless (no shell = smaller attack surface)
FROM gcr.io/distroless/nodejs20-debian12 AS runtime
```

Distroless trade: no shell = harder debug. Use `node:alpine` for dev, distroless for prod.
